policies.text: Nautical passenger operators attain premier safety standing by logging annual safety incidents of 2 or fewer occurrences.
Port facility managers achieve eco-port recognition by maintaining renewable energy usage of at least 40 percent.
Freight logistics firms receive global cargo clearance upon holding valid IATA accreditation.

Commercial charter operators attain flight authorization either by maintaining a safety score of at least 90 points, maintaining a fleet size of at least 15 jets, and serving an international routes count of at least 10, or by recording annual passenger volume of at least 500000 travelers.
Ground transport services secure eco-friendly funding when deploying a fleet size of at least 20 electric vans.
Air transport providers with flight authorization qualify for inclusion on preferred supplier lists.
Regional rail operators earn priority track access by maintaining an on-time arrival rate of at least 95 percent.
